name: extaggerated
description: Extaggerated Obsidian plugin for AI-assisted native tagging and node note generation.

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.format: biome check --write package.json package-lock.json biome.json manifest.json tsconfig.json esbuild.config.mjs src scripts
scripts.format:check: node scripts/check-tailwind-vars.mjs && biome check package.json package-lock.json biome.json manifest.json tsconfig.json esbuild.config.mjs src scripts
scripts.test: npm run check:core-quality && npm run check:changed-file-queue && npm run check:tag-batches && npm run check:node-retrieval && npm run check:node-document && npm run check:node-input

author: Felix Folkebrant
